claims.statement: A belt was to be presented to Tom Allen at the Theatre Comique on May 4, 1870.
claims.excerpt: The presentation ef a splendid belt to Tom Allen,

claims.statement: The presentation to Tom Allen at the Theatre Comique was postponed a second time on May 4, 1870.
claims.excerpt: was to have taken placelast night at the Theatre Comique, but was postponed a second time.

claims.statement: Coburn was to spar with Tom Allen at the presentation but was out of town.
claims.excerpt: Coburn, who was to have sparred with Allen, was out of town.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was to fight Mace on May 10, 1870, and the belt presentation was to follow that combat.
claims.excerpt: It is intended to make the presentation after the combat between Allen and Mace, on the 10th instant.

fights.excerpt: It is intended to make the presentation after the combat between Allen and Mace, on the 10th instant.
fights.notes: Planned bout; the text does not say it was fought. Mace is printed without a first name.

notes: Hints named Jem Mace and St. Louis; the text gives only Mace and the Theatre Comique.
